justifications.technical_correctness: Gravity, floor-gated jump, horizontal movement and the one-time coin pickup are all correct.
justifications.api_correctness: Valid APIs: move_and_slide, get_axis, body_entered.connect, is_in_group, emit.
justifications.version_compatibility: Uses Godot 4 idioms. Newer get_gravity() not used, but the ProjectSettings read is still valid.
justifications.architectural_quality: Clean and decoupled through the signal. Gravity read once at init and a hardcoded group are minor concerns.
justifications.requirement_fulfillment: Covers movement, jump, gravity and a single-emission pickup with player filtering.
justifications.source_quality: No documentation or knowledge sources cited. The claims rest only on the explanation.
justifications.provenance: No traceable references or note ids. The claims are unattributed.
justifications.hallucinations: No invented APIs or behaviors found. The queue_free and is_on_floor claims are accurate.
justifications.clarity: Clear, actionable explanation for each file and design choice.
